notes: All paths are dot-paths relative to the spec root.
This catalog is machine-readable and intended for UI-driven JSON builders.
Filter param details live in docs/filters.md; this file lists filter types and common container shapes.

volume_surge.summary: Detect volume spikes by z-score or ratio.

poc_distance.summary: Price within distance of active POC.

session_time.summary: Allow trades in a session window.

day_of_month.summary: Allow first/last N days of month.

intraday_time.summary: Allow trades in a time-of-day window.

k_consecutive.summary: K consecutive candles in same direction.

daily_trades_cap.summary: Limit number of entries per day.

trend.summary: Trend direction via HH/HL or EMA.

mtf_anomaly.summary: Block when anomalies appear on both timeframes.

htf_poi.summary: Price interacts with active HTF zones/POI levels.

orderflow_delta.summary: Orderflow delta/ratio filter (buy vs sell volume).
